evals.prompt: Document the credit pricing and overage charges feature of the fixture
evals.expected_output: be-feature-documenter (via /dev:document-feature) writes a three-level set under docs/features/ of a git-committed copy of evals/fixture/: <feature>.md, <feature>.behind-the-scenes.md, <feature>.technical.md, matching the golden examples in shape.
expectations: Exactly three files for the feature exist under docs/features/: the guide, *.behind-the-scenes.md and *.technical.md
`python3 scripts/doc-lint.py --dir <output dir>` exits 0
The exact values £6.00, 8 credits, 24 hours and 3 credits appear in the Level 1 guide
The Level 1 worked example contains the arithmetic line for the Masterclass booking with 6 of 8 credits used: shortfall 1 credit × £6.00 = £6.00, and the result is correct
No `#confirmed` tier tag appears in any file except the one sentence in Level 3's `How to read this` legend that says it is never written

Level 1 contains no HTTP status code, no file name (*.cs, *.json), no class name (e.g. CreditPricingService, BookingCancelledHandler, OverageChargeJob, Outbox) and neither the word 'handler' nor 'outbox'

Level 3 has a Finding that a redelivered booking confirmation is priced twice (no idempotency key), with a boundary condition (e.g. delivery fails after the save, the retry spends credits / accrues overage a second time)
Neither Level 1 nor Level 2 calls the missing idempotency a defect, risk or finding (Level 2 may state at-least-once delivery neutrally)
Level 3 reports that no telemetry exists beyond a single start-up log line (Telemetry section states the search that found nothing)
Level 1 uses the client terms 'Session credits', 'Overage' and 'Monthly allowance'
Level 1 quotes the exact refusal text "That plan name is already taken"
Level 2 names the parts by plain role names (no class names) and Level 3 maps each of those role names to its class/file
All three files carry the same commit sha in their Derived from line, and each carries an Audience line (Level 1 shareable, Levels 2 and 3 internal)
